nodes.name: Execute Workflow Trigger
nodes.notes:
Triggered by WF-07-A (Signal Completion) after all required DD flags are set.
Expected input: { case_id: BIGINT }

parameters.query:
SELECT
    c.case_id,
    c.applicant_type,
    c.applicant_id,
    c.status,
    c.created_at,
    c.primary_contact_name AS applicant_name,
    c.primary_contact_email AS applicant_email,

    -- KYC result
    ck.raw_result                   AS kyc_result,
    ck.kyc_provider                 AS kyc_provider,
    ck.checked_at                   AS kyc_checked_at,

    -- Reference analysis
    cra.analysis_json               AS reference_analysis,

    -- Research agent reports
    ra1.report                      AS ra01_report,
    ra2.report                      AS ra02_report,
    ra3.report                      AS ra03_report,
    ra4.report                      AS ra04_report,
    ra5.report                      AS ra05_report,
    ra6.report                      AS ra06_report,

    -- Meeting analyses (all meetings for this case)
    COALESCE(json_agg(DISTINCT cm.analysis_json) FILTER (WHERE cm.analysis_json IS NOT NULL), '[]') AS meeting_analyses,

    -- Received documents metadata
    COALESCE(json_agg(DISTINCT cd.metadata) FILTER (WHERE cd.metadata IS NOT NULL AND cd.status = 'received'), '[]') AS documents,

    -- Gate state
    gi.required_inputs,
    gi.gate_triggered_at

FROM car_cases c
LEFT JOIN car_case_kyc ck               ON ck.case_id = c.case_id
LEFT JOIN car_case_reference_analysis cra ON cra.case_id = c.case_id
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra1               ON ra1.case_id = c.case_id AND ra1.agent = 'RA-01'
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra2               ON ra2.case_id = c.case_id AND ra2.agent = 'RA-02'
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra3               ON ra3.case_id = c.case_id AND ra3.agent = 'RA-03'
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra4               ON ra4.case_id = c.case_id AND ra4.agent = 'RA-04'
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra5               ON ra5.case_id = c.case_id AND ra5.agent = 'RA-05'
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra6               ON ra6.case_id = c.case_id AND ra6.agent = 'RA-06'
LEFT JOIN car_case_meetings cm          ON cm.case_id = c.case_id
LEFT JOIN car_case_documents cd         ON cd.case_id = c.case_id
LEFT JOIN car_case_gate_inputs gi       ON gi.case_id = c.case_id

WHERE c.case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}'
GROUP BY
    c.case_id, c.applicant_type, c.applicant_id, c.status,
    c.created_at, c.primary_contact_name, c.primary_contact_email,
    ck.raw_result, ck.kyc_provider, ck.checked_at,
    cra.analysis_json,
    ra1.report, ra2.report, ra3.report, ra4.report, ra5.report, ra6.report,
    gi.required_inputs, gi.gate_triggered_at;

nodes.name: Postgres: Aggregate DD Inputs
nodes.notes:
Full aggregation join query. Estimated 20â€“60k tokens of context when
all RA reports are populated. Indexes on case_id across all tables are
required for acceptable latency.

nodes.name: IF: applicant_type = Fund?
nodes.notes:
Routes Fund applicants through CR-05 (Fund Mandate Risk Summary)
before the main CR-03 DD Report call.

nodes.name: HTTP: CR-05 Fund Mandate Risk Summary
nodes.notes: Calls Gemini 2.5-flash for CR-05. Response is structured JSON (responseMimeType: application/json). Output is the fund_risk_summary that feeds into CR-03. Timeout: 120s.

nodes.name: Code: Extract CR-05 Result
nodes.notes: Parses the Gemini JSON response. If extraction fails, logs a warning and continues with a fallback so the DD report is not completely blocked.

nodes.name: Code: Non-Fund Passthrough
nodes.notes:
Sets fund_risk_summary to null for Individual and Corporate cases
so downstream nodes have a consistent shape.

nodes.name: Code: Merge Branches
nodes.notes:
Merge point after the fund/non-fund branch. Both paths arrive here
with the same data shape before calling CR-03.

nodes.name: HTTP: CR-03 DD Report Generation
nodes.notes: Gemini 2.5-flash â€” highest-stakes output. Structured JSON enforced via responseMimeType. Estimated input: 20â€“60k tokens. Estimated output: 2â€“4k tokens. Timeout: 180s.

nodes.name: Code: Extract & Render CR-03
nodes.notes:
Parses the CR-03 tool call, renders the structured JSON into a
formatted markdown DD report, and builds file paths for storage.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO car_case_dd_report (
    case_id,
    fund_risk_summary,
    executive_summary,
    risk_rating,
    fit_and_proper,
    fund_specific_findings,
    red_flags,
    orange_flags,
    outstanding_items,
    recommended_decision,
    conditions,
    rationale,
    cr03_raw_response,
    cr05_raw_response,
    report_md_path,
    report_json_path,
    model_used,
    input_token_count,
    output_token_count
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.case_id }}',
    {{ $json.fund_risk_summary ? JSON.stringify($json.fund_risk_summary) + '::jsonb' : 'NULL' }},
    '{{ $json.dd_report.executive_summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.dd_report.risk_rating }}',
    '{{ $json.dd_report.fit_and_proper_assessment.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $json.dd_report.fund_specific_findings ? `'${$json.dd_report.fund_specific_findings.replace(/'/g, "''")}' ` : 'NULL' }},
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.red_flags) }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.orange_flags) }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.outstanding_items) }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ $json.dd_report.recommended_decision }}',
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.conditions || []) }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ $json.dd_report.rationale.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.cr03_raw_response) }}'::jsonb,
    {{ $json.cr05_raw_response ? `'${JSON.stringify($json.cr05_raw_response)}'::jsonb` : 'NULL' }},
    '{{ $json.report_path }}',
    '{{ $json.report_json_path }}',
    'gemini-2.5-flash',
    {{ $json.input_token_count || 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.output_token_count || 'NULL' }}
)
RETURNING report_id;

nodes.name: Postgres: Save DD Report
nodes.notes:
Persists the structured DD report to case_dd_report table.
report_id is returned for use in downstream nodes.

nodes.name: Storage: Save Report Markdown
nodes.notes:
Save the rendered markdown DD report to file storage.
Path: /Applicants/{applicant_id}/06_DD_Report/dd_report_{ts}.md
Switch to your actual storage node type (S3 / local / SharePoint) as needed.

SharePoint via Graph API. Replace SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID in URL and PLACEHOLDER_GRAPH_CRED_ID with real credential.

nodes.name: Storage: Save Report JSON
nodes.notes:
Save raw structured JSON alongside the markdown for programmatic
access by downstream workflows (CR-04, WF-08).

SharePoint via Graph API. Replace SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID in URL and PLACEHOLDER_GRAPH_CRED_ID with real credential.

nodes.name: Teams: Send and Wait for Approval
nodes.notes:
Sends DD report summary to #alphanode-senior-counsel with four buttons:
Proceed | Proceed with Conditions | Decline | Request More Info.
Workflow is suspended until a senior staff member clicks a button.
Slack must have the interactive components URL configured to n8n webhook.
SLA chase: if no response after 5 business days, a separate cron triggers a chase Slack message.

nodes.name: Code: Parse Slack Decision
nodes.notes:
Normalises the Slack button callback into a decision string.
Expected values: 'true' (Proceed), 'false' (Decline),
'more_info', 'proceed_with_conditions'.

nodes.name: IF: Decision = Proceed?
nodes.notes:
TRUE: Proceed (or Proceed with Conditions â€” handled by checking
proceed_with_conditions value in downstream branches).
FALSE: Decline or Request More Info â€” routed to separate branches.

nodes.name: IF: Decision = More Info?
nodes.notes: Distinguishes More Info from Decline on the FALSE branch of IF: Proceed.

parameters.query:
UPDATE car_cases
   SET status = 'dd_approved',
       dd_approved_at = NOW(),
       dd_approved_by = '{{ $json.decision_made_by }}'
 WHERE case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}';

UPDATE car_case_gate_inputs
   SET decision = CASE
         WHEN '{{ $json.slack_decision }}' = 'proceed_with_conditions' THEN 'proceed_with_conditions'::car_dd_decision
         ELSE 'proceed'::car_dd_decision
       END,
       decision_made_at = NOW(),
       decision_made_by = '{{ $json.decision_made_by }}'
 WHERE case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}';

SELECT '{{ $json.case_id }}'::bigint AS case_id, NOW() AS approved_at;

nodes.name: Postgres: Update Status to Approved
nodes.notes: STATUS TRANSITION — sets car_cases.status='dd_approved' after the DD report and any required staff review concluded with approval. Hands off to WF-08 (engagement letter).

nodes.name: Execute: WF-08 Engagement Letter
nodes.notes:
Fire-and-forget trigger for WF-08 (Engagement Letter generation).
Replace WF-08-ENGAGEMENT-LETTER with actual n8n workflow ID after import.

nodes.name: Postgres: Update Status to Declined

Decline email is deliberately opaque â€” does not state specific reasons

parameters.query:
-- Reset gate_triggered_at to allow re-firing once the applicant
-- provides the requested information
UPDATE car_case_gate_inputs
   SET gate_triggered_at = NULL,
       decision = 'more_info_requested'::car_dd_decision,
       decision_made_at = NOW(),
       decision_made_by = '{{ $json.decision_made_by }}'
 WHERE case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}';

SELECT case_id FROM car_case_gate_inputs WHERE case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}';

nodes.name: Postgres: Reset Gate for More Info
nodes.notes:
Resets gate_triggered_at to NULL so the gate can re-fire once
the outstanding items are provided and their _ready flags are re-set.
